# Support infrastructure for humans & agents

Plain is the agentic platform to orchestrate customer work. Turn every conversation into faster answers, better products, and customers who stay.

[![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/bx6e1B0NPWjeBSY2Gd20EqLJhLc.svg?width=480&height=96)](https://plain.com/customers/n8n)

## One place where your team and agents work together.

Connect every customer conversation to the right people, context, and tools. Your agents work from the same threads, account history, and knowledge as your team.

Account context inside the thread

Access past threads, account data, and knowledge from your tools on one customer record to answer quickly and accurately.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/t3EoZ6PRckz3CuAzB84ZWAp2F0.png?width=1902&height=2000)

“For the first time, I have a platform that’s actually keeping up with what we want to build. Plain gave us the foundation to run support the way we wanted, with clean data and custom implementations. Everything is in one place.”

## Let agents do the work, yours or ours.

Every agent works in the same threads as your team.

**Sidekick**T-2088Working…

Set its rules

Choose its tone, what it answers, and which customers it talks to.

Keep your knowledge up-to-date

When it finds a knowledge gap, it hands the thread to your team and suggests updates.

Test it on real threads

Use Test Mode to see its draft replies on live traffic before you turn it on.

Joseph Myers

Why is our invoice $480 higher this month?

## What happens when teams switch to Plain.

### Vercel’s customers get issues resolved 50% faster

Vercel moved support to Plain in just two weeks. Customer feedback now reaches product, security, engineering, and finance, and each support engineer handles 38% more threads.

#### 20x volume with just 2x the team

n8n’s support volume grew twentyfold while its team only doubled, with AI handling 70%+ of tickets.

#### 3x automated resolution in four months

Resend’s automated resolution rate went from 10% to 33%, with no negative sentiment on the automated replies.

#### First response in 3 min, down from an hour

Voltage Park cut first response time by 95%, from over an hour to 3 minutes, after moving off Freshdesk.

### Migrate in days.

Bring every ticket and channel with you, from whichever tools you use today.

Consolidated into Plain

### 5 → 1 tools

To onboard from Jira

### 2 days

Migrated without errors, from Zendesk and Salesforce

### 99% of tickets

### Engineered with enterprise-level security. Built for everyone.

SOC2 Type II and GDPR compliant, with SSO and SCIM.
